verdict.what: a striped coastal lighthouse with a timber keeper's cottage beside it
verdict.style: classic vanilla Minecraft maritime, coastal village
verdict.looks: A tall round-ish tower of white and light-grey blocks with bold dark-red bands, perhaps six or seven stripes, stepped slightly at each change of wall. It has a stone-brick plinth at the base and a grey stepped cornice under a glazed lantern room with thin fence-post railings and a red cap with a small spire. Beside it sits a single-storey cottage with a dark spruce, stepped gable roof, a stone chimney, grey plaster walls, stone-brick footing, dark log corner posts and small windows. A fence and a few posts sit on the grass, which runs to a water edge on one side.
verdict.summary: A readable, well-proportioned lighthouse and keeper's cottage whose only polish left is smoothing the stair-stepped roof edges and tidying the lantern-gallery detail.
